title: Transfer a call without losing context
summary: Pass caller identity and state with the transfer so the next call leg receives the context.
scenario: The thing that breaks on every other platform

folds: variant: two agents on one AgentServer
evidence: demo afterhours / bobbystable swml_change_context (same-agent context switch, not a transfer)

resolved: params.persist_global_data restores global_data when a new AI session starts on the same call (sdk schema.json AIParams); SDK finding: execute_swml(transfer=True) puts the transfer flag inside the SWML document, unlike connect() and the documented action shape - build the action explicitly
